## Functions

### nodeRuntimeHost()

```ts
function nodeRuntimeHost(observeFailure): NodeRuntimeHost;
```

The Node event loop as Shiitake's runtime host: one reconciliation at a time,
re-run when woken during a pass, and a timer for the earliest due retry. It has
no queue policy; Watchdog owns execution and retries. `observeFailure` sees a
failed pass, which is retried after five seconds; if it throws, the throw is
logged and the retry still happens.

### acquireNodeStoreLease()

```ts
function acquireNodeStoreLease(sidecarPath): NodeStoreLease;
```

Claim one store for this process: an exclusive transaction held open on a
sidecar file, so a second owner of the same store is refused at once and the
claim ends with the process, never with a missed heartbeat.

### openNodeShiitake()

```ts
function openNodeShiitake(options): Promise<
  Readonly<{
    agent: ShiitakeOwnerAgent;
    routes: Hono<ShiitakeHttpEnv>;
    close: () => Promise<void>;
  }>
>;
```

Open one durable Agent in a SQLite file on disk. The process holds an exclusive
lease on the store until `close`, so a second opener is refused. The store and
its lease file are private to this user (0600), and a store reached through a
symbolic link or with a second hard link is refused. Accepted work survives a
restart: reopening the file resumes it.

#### Parameters

| `options` | [`NodeShiitakeOptions`](#nodeshiitakeoptions) |
